mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 79 degrees with overcast conditions near Reddan Soccer Park. Our air quality index is currently 54, and tonight we have a full moon. If you are up late, the space station will be visible at 3:26 AM, appearing in the northwest near Cross Plains and moving toward the northeast near Madison. We expect an overnight low of 63 degrees with no rain.

City officials have announced that September is Hunger Action Month to fight local food insecurity, and construction crews will be working on Highway M this coming Monday and Tuesday for utility updates, so expect some potential traffic delays.

There is a great lineup this week with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, the Dane County Farmer's Market tomorrow, and the Verona Area Kids Triathlon taking place this Sunday.

On August 19, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash on North Main Street at Bering Drive, where two drivers were cited for various traffic infractions including operating without a valid license and failing to yield at a stop sign.
Today's flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Overload, and with Culver's open until 10:30 PM, it is the perfect time to stop by for a scoop before they close for the night.
